name: company-kernel
description: Compile a thin agent system and current project context for ambitious startups and fast-moving projects.

interface.shortDescription: Compile the agent system around the project
interface.longDescription: Inspect existing instructions, skills, tools, repository state, and evidence; build a thin 1-10 line system layer; reconcile capabilities; then create or refresh adaptive project context without replacing stronger local rules.
defaultPrompt: Use $system-integrate for first installation, system-context compilation, skill cleanup, or a full agent-environment audit.
Use $project-context when project truth changes after integration.
Use $project-research to resolve a project-shaping uncertainty with current evidence.
